title: Crispy Shrimp Fajitas avec Fromage
description: A French twist on the Mexican classic, featuring succulent shrimp and crispy vegetables.
instructions: Brush tortillas with olive oil and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
In a large skillet, heat butter over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until pink and cooked through.
Add sliced red onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Sprinkle fajita seasoning over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Warm tortillas in the oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until pliable.
Assemble fajitas by placing shrimp and vegetables onto tortillas, followed by a sprinkle of mexican cheese blend.
